lucy: quick FYI - hit a hang in Go generator streaming when cancelling during auth refresh. tiny repro below.

lucy: pattern: call Generator.Stream(ctx) then cancel ctx after first token. sometimes Next() never returns and process hangs. observed locally + CI.

lucy: repro snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter := client.Generator().Stream(ctx, prompt)
go func() {
  for iter.Next() {
    fmt.Print(iter.Value())
    if strings.Contains(iter.Value(), "\n") { cancel() }
  }
  log.Println("done")
}()
// sometimes program blocks here even after cancel
```

omar: can you paste logs/pprof? Err() nil when it hangs?

lucy: Err() often nil. pprof shows goroutine stuck in http2 response read. server log: "auth refresh" then connection close.

devrel: sounds like iterator read loop isn't unblocked by ctx cancel in a few edge cases (mid-handshake / auth retry). UX options: add Close()/Abort() on iterator, make Next() select on ctx.Done(), or add TryNext() non-blocking.

omar: Close() seems safest since many samples pass context.Background(). explicit Close() gives deterministic cleanup.

lucy: I made a tiny wrapper as stopgap that returns a Close() which cancels an internal ctx. works in my repro.

lucy: wrapper sketch:
```go
type CloseIter struct{ It *generator.Iterator; cancel context.CancelFunc }
func (c *CloseIter) Close() { c.cancel() }
```

devrel: please open an issue with repro, pprof and wrapper. maintainers will weigh API change. tests we need: cancel during handshake, cancel during auth retry, concurrent Close()+Next()+Err() races.

omar: I'll add a docs snippet to quickstart showing recommended patterns: one-shot clients should use context.WithTimeout, servers should Close() streams on shutdown.

ci-bot: CI run for lucy/stream-repro: passed (linux/amd64). :white_check_mark:

lucy: filed issue #4890 with repro + pprof + wrapper. thanks folks :rocket:
